relations.description: Rewriting the input in Kenyan English / Kiswahili / Sheng code-switching must not change the answer. Most evaluation suites never test this; Kenyan users write this way every day.
Asking the same thing in different words must not change the answer.
A few keyboard typos in the question must not change the answer.
Swapping irrelevant person names for other names must not change the answer (outputs are mapped back to the original names before comparing).
Formatting noise in the input must not change the shape of a JSON output.
